subject: Westbridge hotel: room block, guest preferences, and contracting for Dec executive workshop
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara@meridiantravel.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon King <devon.king@westbridgehotel.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Westbridge — initial room block + dietary/access needs for Redwood exec workshop

Hi Rishi,

Quick intro — Sara from Meridian Travel (we're handling logistics for Redwood's Dec 14-16 executive workshop). Per our call last week, Westbridge has the availability to hold a block of rooms for your group. Devon copied here is the hotel's group sales manager and will own contract/pricing.

Current ask from Redwood:
- Block: 48 total room nights over 2 nights (Dec 14 arrival / Dec 16 checkout)
- Room mix: 18 king single, 12 double-queen, 6 junior suites (for VIPs), 6 meeting rooms for breakouts (separate booking)
- Early check-in for 8 VIPs arriving between 09:00–11:00 on Dec 14
- Accessibility needs: 3 ADA-accessible rooms (hear/visual alert), 1 roll-in shower
- Dietary: 6 vegetarian, 3 pescatarian, 1 gluten-free; welcome reception to be vegetarian-forward

Devon — can you confirm (1) available room inventory across those categories, (2) contracted rate per room type (including tax/folio handling), (3) cutoff/date for final rooming list and attrition terms, and (4) whether the hotel can accommodate early check-in for the VIPs (fee or comp)?

Rishi — copy for Marissa and Monica for budget and traveler preferences. I'll assemble the initial rooming manifest once we have the inventory.

Thanks,
Sara Holt
Senior Account Manager | Meridian Travel
attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara@meridiantravel.com>, Devon King <devon.king@westbridgehotel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — initial room block + dietary/access needs for Redwood exec workshop

Thanks Sara — and Devon, appreciate you jumping in. A few clarifications from our side before you quote final numbers: 

1) VIPs and suites: the 6 junior suites will be reserved for C-level attendees and two product leaders; those need adjoining rooms where possible. Please note names will be provided by Dec 7.
2) Early check-in: if possible we'd like complimentary early check-in for those 8 VIPs; otherwise a capped fee (<= $50 per room) is acceptable.
3) ADA: we'll provide specific names for the accessible rooms, but please confirm if the property has visual alert alarms (we require) and a roll-in shower on-site.
4) Billing: Redwood will pay master bill for meeting rooms and F&B; individual room incidentals on guest cards. Any incidental charges applied to master folio must be approved by Redwood Travel.

Marissa — please confirm the per-person F&B cap for the welcome reception and whether the company card will be used or expense reports. Monica — I'll need headcounts for the vegetarian/pescatarian/gluten-free items by Dec 7. Ben — can you be the point for the A/V and breakout room layouts so I can pass that to Devon's events team?

Devon — if you can send a preliminary contract and a blank rooming manifest CSV, we can start populating and share the DocuSign link for signature.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships (Sales) | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Devon King <devon.king@westbridgehotel.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sara Holt <sara@meridiantravel.com>
Cc: sales@westbridgehotel.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Westbridge — initial room block + dietary/access needs for Redwood exec workshop

Hi Rishi / Sara,

Thanks for the detail. Confirming availability and answers below based on current inventory:
- Inventory: 20 king single, 15 double-queen, 8 junior suites (2 can be configured as adjoining), 4 ADA-accessible rooms (1 with roll-in shower).
- Rates (net to your master account): King single $299/night, Double-queen $259/night, Junior suite $525/night (suite upgrades may be limited). Rates subject to 10% tax + resort fee.
- Cutoff: Final rooming list due Dec 9 for full block guarantee. Room attrition: 10% allowed without penalty; beyond that nightly charge applies at 70% of contracted rate.
- Early check-in: we can provide complimentary early check-in for up to 4 VIP rooms based on availability; additional early check-ins will incur $40 fee per room.
- ADA/alerts: the property has visual alarm capability in the accessible rooms; roll-in shower confirmed in one room. We recommend booking the 3 other ADA rooms now to ensure availability.

I've attached: Westbridge_Retail_Contract_v2.pdf (redline includes attrition and cancellation terms) and Westbridge_Master_Rooming_Manifest.csv (template). Please review and let me know any redlines.

Attachments: Westbridge_Retail_Contract_v2.pdf, Westbridge_Master_Rooming_Manifest.csv

Kind regards,
Devon King

Looping you all with Devon's contract and manifest template attached by the hotel. Action items: 

- Marissa: confirm whether company card will cover welcome reception (estimate attached in hotel contract) or if we go expense claim. Need decision by EOD Dec 4.
- Monica: please fill out the dietary spreadsheet in the shared drive (link below) with names and restrictions by Dec 7.
- Ben: review breakout room specs and A/V requirements; I put you down to coordinate with Devon's events ops. Can you confirm whether we need two projector feeds in the main breakout? Reply by Dec 4 so I can consolidate.
- I'll upload the rooming manifest and start assigning the ADA and adjoining-suite requests once Marissa confirms payment method.
